question.text: Will the U.S. remove the Section 338 tariff action on Canada by 2026-08-22?

documents.title: USTR announces Section 338 investigation into Canadian trade practices
documents.text: The U.S. Trade Representative today opened a Section 338 action concerning Canada tariffs and discriminatory duties on U.S. exports.

documents.title: Canada Finance signals willingness to negotiate on tariffs
documents.text: Canada's finance ministry indicated openness to a trade deal to de-escalate the Section 338 tariff dispute.

documents.title: Federal Register notice: Section 338 duties on Canada effective date set
documents.text: A Federal Register notice sets an effective date for Section 338 tariff duties on Canadian imports, with a named rate and sector list.

documents.title: Reports of a framework deal to remove Section 338 tariffs
documents.text: Officials describe a framework agreement that would suspend and remove the Section 338 tariff action on Canada, a de-escalation.

documents.title: Federal Register: Section 338 action on Canada partially removed
documents.text: The Section 338 tariff measure affecting Canada is removed for most sectors following a trade agreement, a clear de-escalation.
